description: Event-driven notification and communication workflow for telco billing and tariff management, covering event ingestion, routing, template resolution, channel delivery, status tracking, retries, and customer preferences.

customer_id.description: Unique customer identifier in the telco billing system

account_id.description: Billing account identifier associated with a customer

subscription_id.description: Subscription or line identifier (e.g., MSISDN, SIM, or service line)

notification_event_id.description: Identifier for a business event that triggers notifications (e.g., bill_generated)

notification_rule_id.description: Identifier for routing and template rules applied to events

notification_batch_id.description: Batch identifier grouping one or more notification jobs generated from a single event

notification_job_id.description: Identifier of a single notification job for a specific customer and channel

actor_ref.description: Reference to the actor (human user or system) performing an action.

attachment_ref.description: Attachment reference: file or external link.

tag_filter.description: Tag-based filter with key/value match and operators.

functions.name: ingest_notification_event
functions.description: Ingest a business event related to billing or tariff changes that may trigger notifications.

notification_event_id.description: Optional external event reference; generated if not provided.

event_type.description: Type of business event that occurred.

customer_context.description: Context about the customer and related entities.

segment.description: Customer segment code (e.g., prepaid, postpaid, enterprise).

billing_cycle.description: Billing cycle identifier or date range.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata for routing and auditing.

priority.description: Priority of the event for notification processing.

functions.returns: Created notification_event record with normalized notification_event_id and initial routing status.

functions.name: evaluate_notification_rules
functions.description: Evaluate routing and template rules for an ingested notification event to determine which notifications to create.

notification_event_id.description: Identifier of the previously ingested event.

override_context.description: Optional overrides for context used in rule conditions.

rule_filters.description: Filter rules by attributes before evaluation.

functions.returns: Evaluation result including matched notification_rule_ids, recommended channels, and a new notification_batch_id with preliminary jobs (pending template resolution).

functions.name: generate_notification_batch
functions.description: Generate a notification batch and individual jobs from evaluated rules and templates.

notification_rule_ids.description: Specific rules to use; if omitted, engine uses previously evaluated rules for this event.

max_recipients.description: Maximum number of recipients to include in this batch.

split_by_channel.description: Whether to create separate batches per channel.

override_templates.description: Optional overrides for specific (rule, channel) pairs.

functions.returns: A notification_batch_id and a list of created notification_job_ids with assigned templates and channels in 'pending_delivery' state.

functions.name: resolve_notification_template
functions.description: Resolve and render notification templates into channel-specific payloads for a given job.

notification_job_id.description: Identifier of the notification job to resolve.

template_id.description: Optional template override; otherwise job's assigned template is used.

fallback_locale.description: Fallback locale if requested locale is not available.

personalization_overrides.description: Explicit values to override dynamic placeholders.

sensitive_fields.description: List of fields to mask or partially hide in the payload.

preview_mode.description: If true, does not persist final payload, only returns a preview.

functions.returns: Resolved channel-specific payload (e.g., SMS text, email subject/body, push JSON) and updated job status (ready_for_delivery or preview_only).

functions.name: send_notification_batch
functions.description: Dispatch all ready-for-delivery jobs in a notification batch to their respective channels.

send_at.description: Time at which to start sending.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone for schedule interpretation.

functions.returns: Dispatch summary including counts per channel, list of notification_job_ids updated to 'sent', and any immediate delivery errors.

functions.name: get_notification_status
functions.description: Retrieve status and delivery details for notification jobs or batches.

notification_job_ids.description: List of specific job IDs to query.

notification_batch_id.description: Batch ID; if provided without job_ids, returns status for all jobs in the batch.

functions.returns: Status objects for each requested notification_job_id or for all jobs in the specified batch, with optional delivery and audit details.

functions.name: retry_notification_delivery
functions.description: Retry delivery for failed or timed-out notification jobs, with optional modifications to channel or payload.

retry_strategy.description: Controls when and how retries are executed.

channel_fallbacks.description: Channel fallback rules ordered by preference.

apply_on_error_codes.description: Provider-specific error codes that trigger this fallback.

limit_per_customer.description: Optional limit of retries per customer to avoid flooding.

functions.returns: Retry plan and updated job records indicating which jobs were scheduled for retry and their new attempt counts.

functions.name: cancel_or_suppress_notification
functions.description: Cancel pending notifications or mark them as suppressed due to updated customer state or errors.

action.description: Whether to cancel jobs or mark them as suppressed.

functions.returns: Summary of affected notification_job_ids, their new status (canceled/suppressed), and any jobs that could not be updated due to terminal states.

functions.name: update_customer_notification_preferences
functions.description: Create or update a customer's notification preferences across channels and event types.

scope.description: Applies preferences at customer or subscription level.

allowed_event_types.description: If set, only these event types can use this channel.

quiet_hours.description: Time windows where notifications should be delayed or suppressed.

start_time.description: Local time start in HH:MM format.

end_time.description: Local time end in HH:MM format.

functions.returns: Updated customer notification preference record with effective per-channel and per-event settings.

functions.name: get_customer_notification_preferences
functions.description: Retrieve effective notification preferences for a customer, optionally at subscription level.

include_inherited.description: Whether to show inherited preferences (e.g., account-level) in addition to direct settings.

include_history.description: Include change history and audit information.

functions.returns: Effective notification preferences across channels and event types, optionally including inheritance sources and change history.

functions.name: list_notification_rules
functions.description: List or search notification routing rules configured for billing and tariff events.

priority_range.description: Filter rules by their priority weight.

functions.returns: Paged list of notification rules with ids, conditions, channels, templates, and enablement status.

functions.name: upsert_notification_rule
functions.description: Create or update a notification rule that maps events and conditions to channels and templates.

notification_rule_id.description: If provided, updates the existing rule; otherwise creates a new one.

event_type.description: Event type this rule applies to.

conditions.description: Match conditions for when this rule should apply.

usage_threshold_over.description: Minimum usage threshold percentage for rule to apply.

channel_strategies.description: Configuration per channel including templates and importance.

mandatory.description: If true, must attempt this channel even if others succeed.

fallback_order.description: Lower values mean higher priority for fallback.

max_per_day.description: Rate limit for this rule and channel per customer per day.

priority.description: Used to order rule evaluation; lower means higher priority.

functions.returns: Created or updated notification_rule with notification_rule_id, version, and validation results for conditions and templates.

functions.name: audit_notification_flow
functions.description: Retrieve an end-to-end audit trail for a notification event, including rules, batches, jobs, and delivery outcomes.

notification_event_id.description: Primary key for audit; required unless querying by customer and time range.

include.description: Detail levels to include in the audit trail.

redact_sensitive.description: If true, masks PII and sensitive payload fields.

functions.returns: Structured audit report linking notification_event_id to evaluated rules, generated batches and jobs, customer preferences at the time, and detailed delivery timeline per channel.

functions.name: search_telco_notification_entities
functions.description: Faceted search across telco_notification entities supporting tag filters, time windows, full-text, status, and pagination.

projection.description: Optional list of fields to project in the response.

functions.returns: Paginated list of matching telco_notification entities, optional facet counts, and pagination cursors.

functions.name: bulk_create_telco_notification_records
functions.description: Bulk-create up to N telco_notification records in a single atomic-or-best-effort batch with per-item validation results.
functions.returns: Per-record outcome with assigned ids or validation errors, plus an overall batch summary.

functions.name: bulk_update_telco_notification_records
functions.description: Apply a partial update patch to many telco_notification records, optionally with optimistic concurrency checks.
functions.returns: Per-update result with new version ids and a count of successes/failures.

functions.name: bulk_delete_telco_notification_records
functions.description: Delete or soft-delete many telco_notification records in one call, with cascade and dry-run options.
functions.returns: Per-id deletion outcome and references to any cascaded entities.

functions.name: export_telco_notification_dataset
functions.description: Schedule or stream an export of telco_notification data to CSV/JSONL/Parquet, with field selection and filters.
functions.returns: Export job id, estimated row count, and status tracking endpoint.

functions.name: import_telco_notification_dataset
functions.description: Validate and import a telco_notification dataset from a remote URI; supports dry-run and conflict handling.

mapping.description: Source column to target field mapping.

functions.returns: Import job id, row counts (succeeded/failed/skipped), and a sample of validation errors.

functions.name: snapshot_telco_notification_state
functions.description: Create a point-in-time snapshot of one or more telco_notification entities for later restore or comparison.
functions.returns: Snapshot id, size estimate, and retention expiry timestamp.

functions.name: restore_telco_notification_snapshot
functions.description: Restore telco_notification state from a prior snapshot with dry-run preview and conflict resolution.
functions.returns: Restore plan or actual restore result with per-entity status.

functions.name: get_telco_notification_metrics
functions.description: Query aggregated metrics/KPIs for the telco_notification workflow with grouping, filters, and time ranges.
functions.returns: Time-series points per metric and group, with totals and percentiles.

functions.name: build_telco_notification_dashboard
functions.description: Compose a dashboard view across telco_notification metrics, with panels, filters, and a shareable link.
functions.returns: Dashboard id, share URL, and resolved layout metadata.

functions.name: query_telco_notification_audit_events
functions.description: Search the telco_notification audit/change log with filters across actors, actions, resources, and time windows.
functions.returns: Paginated audit events with optional before/after diffs.

functions.name: subscribe_telco_notification_events
functions.description: Create a webhook subscription that delivers telco_notification workflow events to a target URL with retries and signing.
functions.returns: Subscription id, verification challenge if applicable, and active flag.

functions.name: list_telco_notification_subscriptions
functions.description: List webhook subscriptions for telco_notification events with filters and status counts.
functions.returns: Paginated list of subscriptions with last delivery status.

functions.name: delete_telco_notification_subscription
functions.description: Remove a webhook subscription for telco_notification events.
functions.returns: Confirmation with final delivery counters.

functions.name: schedule_telco_notification_job
functions.description: Schedule a recurring or one-off telco_notification job (cron/rrule/interval) with arguments and an owner.
functions.returns: Schedule id and next computed run time.

functions.name: list_telco_notification_schedules
functions.description: List scheduled telco_notification jobs with filters and pagination.
functions.returns: Paginated list of schedules with last/next run timestamps.

functions.name: cancel_telco_notification_schedule
functions.description: Cancel or pause a scheduled telco_notification job.
functions.returns: Updated schedule state.

functions.name: simulate_telco_notification_operation
functions.description: Run a what-if simulation of a telco_notification operation without committing side effects, returning predicted outcomes.
functions.returns: Predicted outcomes, side-effect summary, warnings, and policy hits.

functions.name: request_telco_notification_approval
functions.description: Open an approval request for a telco_notification action, routing to the right approvers and policies.
functions.returns: Approval request id, routed approver list, and SLA timer.

functions.name: decide_telco_notification_approval
functions.description: Record an approve/reject/abstain decision on a telco_notification approval request with required justification.
functions.returns: Updated approval state and downstream effects (e.g., gate releases).

functions.name: add_telco_notification_comment
functions.description: Add a threaded comment or annotation to any telco_notification entity, supporting mentions and attachments.
functions.returns: Comment id, thread id, and updated thread state.

functions.name: list_telco_notification_comments
functions.description: List comments/annotations attached to a telco_notification entity with pagination and filters.
functions.returns: Paginated comment threads with author/timestamp/mentions.

functions.name: upsert_telco_notification_policy
functions.description: Create or update a policy/rule controlling telco_notification behavior, with conditions, effects, and a priority.
functions.returns: Policy id, version, and any conflicts with existing policies.

functions.name: list_telco_notification_policies
functions.description: List telco_notification policies/rules with filters and active flags.
functions.returns: Paginated list of policies with priority and last-modified info.

functions.name: link_telco_notification_entities
functions.description: Create a typed relationship between two telco_notification-related entities (parent/child, depends_on, references).
functions.returns: Link id and a graph delta showing newly-created relationships.

functions.name: get_telco_notification_dependency_graph
functions.description: Return the dependency/relationship graph rooted at a telco_notification entity, up to N hops, with cycle detection.
functions.returns: Nodes/edges of the dependency graph and any cycles detected.

functions.name: tag_telco_notification_entities
functions.description: Add, remove, or replace tags on one or many telco_notification entities.
functions.returns: Updated tag set per entity and count of changes applied.
